contentPattern.structure: category filter tabs (All + one per category) + grid of cards (linked image + linked title + short description)

suitableFor: adventure / product / article listing grids with category filter tabs
any image-title-description card grid where visitors filter by a category
notSuitableFor: simple card grids with no filtering (use vanilla cards)
people / team teaser grids with circular photos and social links (use cards-team)
switching whole long-form content panels (use tabs-adventure)
